dataset.model_input: original RGB only; no SVG, stroke masks, geometry, character ID or gold description
dataset.target: unchanged full five-class ordered description including terminal character

CPU_contract.patch_coordinates: 2D normalized x/y from image grid, no target geometry

method_order.role: frozen pretrained Image-to-Description; execution after separate S2 authorization

method_order.objective: M1 plus symmetric global image/text InfoNCE
M3 plus ordered query slots; slots are not independently qualified stroke instances

actual_training.selection: after real S2 controls, understanding results and measured single-device training feasibility
required_common_controls: same image resolution and token budget
explicit trained/frozen parameter groups and compute costs

program_transfer.G0: source/template oracle executor control; no model ability claim
program_transfer.G1: separately disclosed unordered geometry assistance; do not mix with G2
program_transfer.G2: raw model program from RGB only, before/after training under identical inputs; no reference SVG, target description or gold correction
program_transfer.failure_accounting: one original output per fixed slot; parse, render, decode failures and unavailable gold retained
program_transfer.evaluation: actual decoded RGB; renderer-enforced temporal execution is not evidence of normative model order
program_transfer.generalization: new independent character/font/backbone experiments require separate frozen splits, data permission and qualified labels
